# casdoor_site (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor site, a domain served by the built-in reverse proxy and web application firewall.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_site" "portal" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "portal"
  display_name = "Acme Portal"
  domain       = "portal.acme.example.com"
  host         = "http://10.0.0.5:8080"
  ssl_mode     = "HTTPS Only"
  rules        = ["${casdoor_rule.block_bots.owner}/${casdoor_rule.block_bots.name}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the site, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `alert_interval` (Number) The number of seconds between two health checks.
- `alert_providers` (List of String) The names of the providers that send the alerts.
- `alert_try_times` (Number) The number of failed health checks before an alert is sent.
- `casdoor_application` (String) The application that users must sign in to before reaching the site.
- `disable_verbose` (Boolean) Whether responses to blocked requests leave out the details.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `domain` (String) The domain of the site.
- `enable_alert` (Boolean) Whether alerts are sent when the site is down.
- `host` (String) The upstream that requests are forwarded to.
- `hosts` (List of String) The upstreams that requests are balanced between.
- `need_redirect` (Boolean) Whether the other domains are redirected to the domain.
- `other_domains` (List of String) The other domains of the site.
- `port` (Number) The port of the upstream on the local machine, used when `host` is empty.
- `public_ip` (String) The public IP address that the domain resolves to.
- `rules` (List of String) The rules applied to the site, in the `organization/rule` format.
- `ssl_cert` (String) The name of the cert served for the domain.
- `ssl_mode` (String) The SSL mode, `HTTP`, `HTTPS and HTTP`, `HTTPS Only` or `Static Folder`.
- `tag` (String) The tag.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the site was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the site in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_site.example <organization>/<name>
```
